title: Single nick pCrispomyces 2
author: Jaclyn Winter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8f5htq6
materials: Emilio Cortes Sanchez pCrispomyces 2.0 KO in Streptomyces: Adapted from High-Efficiency Multiplex Genome Editing of Streptomyces Species Using an Engineered CRISPR/Cas System. Cobb RE, Wang Y, Zhao H. ACS Synth Biol. 2014 Dec 8. 10.1021/sb500351f Go to the CRISP-y web : https://crispy.secondarymetabolites.org You can find more info about it at ‘’CRISPy-web: An online resource to design sgRNAs for CRISPR applications in microbes’’ Kai Blin, Lasse Ebdrup Peders en, Tilman n Weber, Sang Yup Lee. Synthetic and Systems Biotechnology 2016: doi:10.1016/j.synbio.2016.01.003 Upload a Fasta file with the regions you want to target. To avoid off target cutting upload the whole assembly. Select Guides with a good score, and if possible cutting near sites in which GC content is not too high, so construction of repair cassette is easier to make (PCR issues). The pCrispomyces vector has the gRNA scaffold already cloned in. We would only need to include the spacer sequence. For that: Design two 24 nt oligonucleotides (4 nt 5’ sticky end + 20 nt spacer sequence) with the sticky ends being: ACGC on the forward primer and AAAC on the reverse primer. For example, if the spacer sequence is CTCACGGACGGAGACCAGGA, then the two primers are: a. Spacer-for: 5’-ACGCCTCACGGACGGAGACCAGGA-3’ b. Spacer-rev: 5’-AAACTCCTGGTCTCCGTCCGTGAG-3’ Such that the annealed product will be: 5’-ACGCCTCACGGACGGAGACCAGGA -3’ 3’- GAGTGCCTGCCTCTGGTCCTCAAA-5’ Clone of our annealed oligo will be done with BbsI (sticky ends for the BbsI sites (5’ to 3’) are ACGC and GTTT). Anneal spacer oligos as follows: a. Resuspend both oligos to 100μM in water b. Mix 5uL FOR + 5uL REV + 90uL 30mM HEPES, pH 7.8 c. Heat to 95°C for 5min, then ramp to 4°C at 0.1°C/sec 5) Insert annealed spacer to plasmid by Golden Gate assembly: Golden Gate reaction mixture: Backbone (pCripspomyces plasmid) X μL 100 ng Insert (annealed oligos) 0.3 μL 3:1 mol ratio (dilute annealed oligos 10-fold) T4 Ligase Buffer (NEB) 2 μL T4 ligase (NEB) 1 μL 400 U/μL stock is sufficient; add last BbsI (NEB) 1 μL

steps.title: Perform Golden Gate Assembly
steps.instruction: Run the Golden Gate reaction using the following thermal cycler program:

substeps.instruction: Cycle 37°C for 10 min and 16°C for 10 min, repeating 10 times total
Incubate at 50°C for 5 min
Incubate at 65°C for 20 min
Hold at 4°C

steps.title: Transform E. coli dh10b
steps.instruction: Transform 3 μL of each reaction into 50 μL of E. coli dh10b via heat shock.

steps.title: Select and Recover Plasmid
steps.instruction: Plate 10% of the recovery culture on selective plates containing 10 μL of 0.5 M IPTG and 40 μL of 20 mg/mL X-gal (in DMSO).

substeps.instruction: Pick white colonies
Recover plasmid from selective LB+

steps.title: Prepare Homology Template Repair
steps.instruction: Create an editing template for the XbaI site in the construct.

substeps.instruction: PCR amplify two homology arms from gDNA of the strain to KO (excluding the cutting site and XbaI site)
Design 20-30 nt overlaps at the junction of the two arms and XbaI cutsites at the opposite ends
Spliced the two arms via overlap-extension PCR
Digest and ligate the product into the digested plasmid
Clone the editing template into the gRNA containing plasmid (optionally dephosphorylate after XbaI cutting if recircularization is high)

steps.title: Verify and Deliver Plasmid
steps.instruction: Verify the plasmid and deliver it to Streptomyces via conjugation or electroporation.

steps.title: Remove Plasmid After Editing
steps.instruction: Incubate the edited strain in non-selective medium at 37°C to remove the plasmid.

steps.title: Prepare E. coli Donor Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare non-methylating E. coli strain ET12567/pUZ8008 containing the required plasmid for intergeneric conjugation.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate a 50 mL culture in a 1-3:100 ratio from an overnight culture
Incubate at 37°C at 220 rpm until OD600 reaches 0.4-0.6
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 4200 x g for 10 min
Wash cells twice with LB medium to remove antibiotics
Resuspend cells in a final volume of 500 μL LB medium

steps.title: Prepare Streptomyces Recipient Spores
steps.instruction: Prepare a suspension of Streptomyces spores at a concentration of 2 x 10^8 spores/mL in 2YT medium.

substeps.instruction: Heat shock the suspension at 50°C for 10 min

steps.title: Perform Intergeneric Conjugation
steps.instruction: Mix the E. coli cells and Streptomyces spores to transfer the plasmid.

substeps.instruction: Mix 500 μL of E. coli cells with 500 μL of spore suspension
Plate the mixture on MS medium
Incubate plates at 30°C for 16-18 h
Overlay plates with 1 mL of a solution containing 500 μg nalidixic acid and 1 mg of the appropriate selection marker
Allow overlay to dry in a laminar flow hood
Incubate until primary exconjugant Streptomyces colonies are observed
